title: Melody from the Grand Piano
description: A dark grand piano with its lid open sits in a shadowy room, illuminated by a faint warm glow from within. Swirling streams of ethereal purple, pink, and gold musical notes and ribbons flow outward from the piano, cascading across the foreground in luminous, fluid patterns.
prompt: A dark grand piano with its lid raised stands in a dimly lit room with deep blue and black shadows. From inside the piano, glowing streams of purple, magenta, and gold musical notes and ribbon-like swirls pour out in elegant flowing patterns, cascading toward the foreground. Painterly style with visible brushstrokes, dramatic lighting, mysterious and melancholic atmosphere.
